t: You're at the Royal Society of Arts, a London-based organisation whose full name is the Royal Society for the Encouragement of Arts, Manufactures and Commerce. People usually just call it the RSA. It was founded by William Shipley, who was an English drawing master, social reformer and inventor. In 1754 he set up an arts society in London, and that society went on to become the RSA you see today. It's a good example of one man's idea growing into a lasting institution.
